item.title: Morning Weather for Saturday, August 29
item.description: Good morning! Happy weekend! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Saturday, August 29. Saturday! No school and no hurry today. Shanghai is going to be a little bit rainy today. It will reach 33 degrees, and drop down to 27 degrees. The chance of rain is 100 percent. Don't forget your umbrella today! Watch out for snails after the rain. They love wet weather! As for tomorrow, expect it to be stormy with thunder and hail, with a high of 32 degrees. A question for you: who would you like to give a hug to today? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
